questions.question: Should transactions and account balances that were already stored incorrectly (short by a cent) before this fix ships be corrected/migrated, or does the fix apply only to amounts entered/imported after it ships?
questions.rationale: This determines whether users' existing balances remain permanently a few cents short (with only future entries fixed) or whether a data migration/backfill is required to restore historical accuracy. It directly changes the scope of work and the user-visible outcome for existing budgets.

questions.question: Is it acceptable to assume all amounts are two-decimal-place (cent-based) currency values, or does the fix need to support currencies/locales with a different number of subunit decimal places (e.g. zero-decimal or three-decimal currencies)?
questions.rationale: This defines the boundary of 'correct' for the fix — if any supported currency uses a non-cent subunit, a fix that only handles two-decimal rounding could leave that currency's amounts under- or over-rounded, so the business needs to confirm the scope before the fix is considered complete.
